description:
The engineering team at AcmeCorp needs a simple way to share files. Create a new directory named 'downloads' inside the public_html folder for the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server (path: /home/acmecorp/public_html/downloads/). Inside this directory, create three empty placeholder files: 'acme_driver_v2.4.exe', 'user_manual_2025.pdf', and 'release_notes.txt'.

Then, configure Apache for this specific directory to ENABLE directory browsing (also known as Directory Indexing or 'Options +Indexes'), so that visitors see a list of files instead of a 403 Forbidden error. You can use Virtualmin's 'Configure Website' / 'Apache Options' or edit the Directives manually.
